test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: GST is a/an:
solution:
The correct answer is __**indirect tax**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GST** stands for Goods and Services Tax and is an **indirect tax** imposed on the supply of goods and services.
 
• It is a comprehensive, multi-stage, destination-based tax that is levied on every value addition.
 
• GST is designed to bring uniformity in the taxation system by replacing various indirect taxes like VAT, service tax, excise duty, etc.
 
• It is implemented to create a single, unified Indian market to make the economy stronger and more efficient.
 
• GST is categorized into Central GST (CGST), State GST (SGST), and Integrated GST (IGST) depending on whether the transaction is intra-state or inter-state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Goods and Services Tax** was implemented in India on **1st July 2017**.
 
• It aims to streamline the taxation process and reduce the cascading effect of taxes on the end consumers.
 
• GST is governed by the GST Council, which consists of the finance ministers of the central and state governments.
 
• The introduction of GST is considered a significant step in the reform of India's indirect tax structure.
 
• The GST regime has several advantages, including the elimination of the tax-on-tax effect, increased compliance, and a broader tax base.
